children.text: Participants
ThinkByte: Raghu, Harsha, vinay kovvuri, Charan, Bharath MVS
Eatfit: Syed Farooq
Key Takeaways
The meeting aimed to address challenges in automating demand planning and data analytics for better procurement and decision-making.
Participants included decision-makers from the procurement and tech teams, such as Bharat, Raghu, Syed, and Harshal, who discussed their roles and responsibilities.
Key issues discussed included automating SQL queries, managing vendor pricing, and improving demand forecasting models, especially for complex queries and data integration.
Follow-up actions include conducting a demo with sample data, involving stakeholders like Sumanta and Renny, and discussing pricing models for the proposed solutions.
The team decided to implement a pilot demonstration, focusing on SQL query automation and demand forecasting, with further discussions planned regarding pricing and stakeholder engagement.

Pain Points
Lack of data accessibility and traceability.
Struggling with handling complex queries such as week-on-week comparisons of different zones for a product with specific ratings.
Current system struggles with complex queries.
Due to a lack of raw materials, only 50 products were sent to the kitchen that day instead of the full order.
Custom models don’t easily integrate with existing systems.
Requesting to share sample data instead of actual data poses a challenge.
Manual processes hinder operational efficiency.
Vendor negotiation difficulties impact demand planning accuracy.
Pure Foods struggles to find new vendors regularly, hindering their ability to explore different price ranges in the market.
There are around 20 main problems that need to be addressed, and the challenge is deciding which ones to prioritize.
Features Interested
Automate data processing and insights.
Integrate text-to-SQL functionality.
Implement price management tools.
Develop a unified database for demand planning.
Current Workflow
Existing workflow involves text-to-SQL conversion.
Data is queried from a database and interpreted by LLM.
Reliance on manual queries is time-consuming.
Queries require complex data structures.
Product pricing updates and demand forecasting should be automated.

Business Goals
Leverage existing data to drive better decision-making.
Establish a single source of truth for insights.
Automate demand planning to improve accuracy.
Simplify pricing updates based on market trends.
Implement SQL to text queries for easy data access.
